metadata.description: bouncer: hidden, calibrated test suites that judge AI coding agents' work. Two plugins: bouncer (local, no sign-in) and bouncer-hosted (Lunox's hosted platform).

plugins.name: bouncer
plugins.description: Independent, hidden test suites written from the spec for AI coding agents. Local only: no MCP server, installing it asks for no sign-in.

plugins.name: bouncer-hosted
plugins.description: Bouncer on Lunox's hosted platform (platform.lunox.work): a bundled MCP server that signs in on first use, and the lunox-contribute skill for invited contributors.
